observations: Photo 0: Front view of a motorcycle with a yellow and red fuel tank, black seat with red trim, and visible handlebars with dual round gauges. Close-up of the frame, especially near the engine and front fork, to check for cracks or bends.
Video showing the lights, horn, and gauges functioning, or close-up of the wiring and battery connections.
Close-up of the front and rear tires showing tread depth and brake pads/rotors.
